style: STYLE: a copperplate engraving or woodcut heraldic emblem, as in a sixteenth-century armorial or a printer's device. Crisp black ink lines on pure white paper; shading only by fine engraved hatching and solid black; strictly black and white with no grey, no colour, no gradients and no soft shadows. Bold, clean, high-contrast forms that stay readable when printed half an inch tall. Grim and weathered rather than shiny: a few nicks and dents in the metal rim, worn edges. Centred and isolated on a plain white background with generous empty margin on every side. No text, letters, numbers, mottoes, signatures or watermarks. No mantling, crest, helm above the shield, supporters, crown, frame, scroll, background scenery or drop shadow.
series: SERIES: this is one of fifteen chapter arms that must look like a matched set. Every shield in the set is the same upright heater shield (flat top, straight sides curving to a point), seen straight on, with the same thick double engraved rim, the same proportions and the same engraving style. Only the field hatching and the central charge change.

items.subject: The emblem of HERALDRY SKIRMISH: THE DYING LANDS, a grim medieval dark-fantasy wargame. A battered heater shield, broken: a jagged crack runs from the top edge down through the shield, and a chunk has broken away from the upper right corner, with two or three small fragments falling below it. On the shield, a single heraldic castle charge: a gatehouse of three crenellated towers, the middle one tallest, with an arched gate and narrow arrow-slit windows; the castle solid black with fine white masonry joints. The field behind the castle is hatched with fine vertical lines (the heraldic convention for red). The shield has a thick double engraved rim, dented and chipped. Noble, ancient and ruined: the arms of a fallen realm.
Charge: an orb surmounted by a cross (a globus cruciger), with a band around its equator and a band rising to the cross. Field: hatched with fine horizontal lines (heraldic blue).
Charge: a single six-sided die in three-quarter view, the visible faces showing one, two and three pips. Field: plain white (heraldic silver).
Charge: an hourglass in a turned wooden frame, sand running from the upper bulb into a heap in the lower. Field: hatched with fine vertical lines (heraldic red).
Charge: a tall riding boot in profile with a large spiked rowel spur at the heel. Field: hatched with fine diagonal lines from upper left to lower right (heraldic green).
Charge: two longswords crossed in saltire, points upward, cross-guards and pommels at the base, filling the shield. Field: hatched with fine vertical lines (heraldic red).
Charge: a swallow-tailed war banner flying from a lance, the banner bearing a small plain cross. Field: hatched with fine horizontal lines (heraldic blue).
Charge: a medieval great helm seen from the front, with a horizontal eye slit, a vertical reinforcing ridge and a cluster of breathing holes. Field: plain white (heraldic silver).
Charge: a tall flame of three tongues rising from a footed iron brazier. Field: hatched with fine diagonal lines from upper right to lower left (heraldic purple).

Charge: a wyvern's head erased (torn off raggedly at the neck), in profile facing left, horned, jaws open showing fangs, a fierce eye. Field: hatched with fine diagonal lines from upper left to lower right (heraldic green).
Charge: a ruined round-arched gateway of stone blocks, one side of the arch collapsed, a few fallen stones at its foot. Field: plain white (heraldic silver).

Charge: a medieval war pavilion (a campaign tent with a peaked roof, scalloped valance and open door flap) with a small pennant flying from its pole. Field: hatched with fine vertical lines (heraldic red).
Charge: a large iron key, bow uppermost with an ornamental quatrefoil opening, wards at the bottom. Field: hatched with fine horizontal lines (heraldic blue).
Charge: a hanging iron lantern with a ring, a pointed cap and glass panes, a small flame inside. Field: plain white (heraldic silver).

Charge: an open book seen from above, lines of text suggested as simple strokes with no readable letters, a ribbon bookmark hanging from the spine. Field: hatched with fine diagonal lines from upper right to lower left (heraldic purple).
Charge: a quill pen set diagonally above a small inkhorn. Field: hatched with fine horizontal lines (heraldic blue).
